metadata.title: Application Observability and Governance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for observing, explaining, and governing application behavior over time.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application logging, metrics, traces, audit events, error handling, and governance workflows.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for ensuring application behavior is observable, explainable, and governable.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Application observability and governance assumes baseline application identity, purpose, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines expectations for application-level audit event generation, review, and coverage.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Reinforces observability as evidentiary accountability rather than operational logging alone.

metadata.remarks: Application Observability and Governance defines trust properties required to understand and oversee application behavior. This pattern addresses logging, telemetry, error handling, and governance visibility without redefining application logic or data access rules.

components.title: Application Behavior Observability
components.description: Provides visibility into application actions, decisions, and execution flow.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or absence of logs to obscure application misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Comprehensive logging and telemetry for accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application activities and decision points are logged.

components.title: Error Handling and Failure Transparency
components.description: Ensures errors and failures are handled predictably and transparently.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or misuse of error conditions to produce unsafe behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled error handling that avoids unsafe state or disclosure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application error handling prevents unsafe information disclosure or logic bypass.

components.title: Governance Visibility and Oversight
components.description: Provides governance bodies with visibility into application behavior and risk posture.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Circumvention of oversight by obscuring application behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define governance expectations and oversight of application behavior.

components.title: Application Audit and Review
components.description: Supports investigation, compliance, and continuous improvement through review.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Destruction or suppression of evidence relevant to application incidents.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit trails supporting investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit analysis supports investigation and governance review of application behavior.
